ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the construction wage theft investigation and the investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar.
questions: What are the financial connections between the different fraud cases in Minnesota?
How much money is involved in these cases?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption or fraud in Minnesota, and this story could have significant implications for the state's government and economy.
